personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK fused with 7 Dark-First Utility
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, dark-glassmorphism operational powerhouse with warm orange glows and frosted glass surfaces that feels both premium and highly functional.

spacing.rule: Use generous spacing to let frosted glass cards breathe. Tighten spacing in the POS grid and Kanban columns for utility density.

do's: Use blur on elevated cards (frosted glass) with a translucent tinted base (rgba(26,26,26, 0.75)).
Apply glass effects on sticky headers, bottom order sheets, and modal scrims.
Add warm orange glows behind featured items or critical CTA buttons using subtle radial gradients.
dont's: Do not blur dense form fields or Kanban card content.
Do not over-blur the background to the point it becomes noisy.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: A unified login gateway for Founder, Admin, Kasir, and Dapur featuring dark glassmorphism and Devrion branding.

states.loading: Orange glow spinner centered on dark background.
states.error: Frosted glass modal with orange/red error text.

screens.layout: Full-screen dark cafe background image with heavy glass scrim. Centered login card (frosted glass, 20-24px rounded). Bold white heading with orange highlight 'Good Food Good Mood!'. Small 'Devrion' logo and tagline at the very bottom. Orange gradient CTA.

screens.name: Customer Menu (Web)
screens.purpose: No-login NFC/QR menu for customers to order directly to their table.
screens.layout: Grid layout of food items with photos. Sticky bottom cart sheet (glassmorphism) over the scrolling menu. Success order animation (Lottie/Reanimated) and digital receipt pop-up upon checkout.

screens.name: Kasir (POS)
screens.purpose: Real-time order taking and management for the cashier.

states.empty: No active orders in the cart.

screens.layout: Responsive split screen: Left 2/3 for menu categories (horizontal chips) and item grid (frosted cards). Right 1/3 fixed glassmorphism sidebar for current order summary, incoming QR orders, and orange CTA 'Send to Kitchen'.

screens.name: Dapur (Kanban)
screens.purpose: Kitchen display system for order progression via drag-and-drop.

states.empty: Illustration of a clean kitchen - 'No active orders.'

screens.layout: Horizontal scrollable board with 4 columns: Baru (New), Dimasak (Cooking), Siap (Ready), Disajikan (Served). Cards use high-contrast dark utility design with elapsed timers. Drag and drop gestures to move tickets between columns.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Management view for reports, menus, tables, and settings.
screens.layout: Sidebar navigation (Drawer on mobile). Main area displays financial report cards, charts, and lists for managing menus, photos, tables (QR code generator), and settings (QRIS, Logo).

screens.name: Founder Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level management of all Cafe & Resto branches without revenue visibility.
screens.layout: Grid of branch cards (frosted glass) displaying active status, location, and staff count. Excludes any financial metrics.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark Glassmorphism theme: use '#0D0D0D' as the app background and '#1A1A1A' with 75% opacity and a blur effect for cards/surfaces.

Accent everything with the warm orange brand color ('#FF7A00'). CTA buttons must use orange linear gradients (e.g., #FF7A00 to #FFA34D vertically) to match the requirement 'orange gradient CTA buttons'.
Headings must be bold and white. Use `<Text>` styling to highlight specific words like 'Good Mood!' in orange.

Implement the Kanban board in the Dapur screen using a responsive horizontal ScrollView containing columns, and `react-native-reanimated` / `react-native-gesture-handler` for drag-and-drop interactions.
The UI must be completely responsive: mobile screens use bottom tabs or drawer, but tablet/desktop should utilize a side navigation and a split POS layout (Menu on left, Cart on right).

For the Devrion branding on the login page: build it using a small SVG 'D' path in navy with cyan accents, accompanied by the text 'Custom Apps, Built for Growth' in small muted typography at the bottom.
Ensure the Customer Menu (Web) uses a sticky bottom cart that overlaps the menu, applying a heavy blur to ensure readability.
MANDATORY: Animate transitions and success states heavily using `react-native-reanimated` to meet the 'Penuh animasi keren' requirement.
